proposed_capability: Arbitrate Needs, Career, Contingencies and Skills from the observed household portrait queues in the existing native callback.
player_save_control_impact: Existing frame and portrait authority gate one submission. No cancellation, save changes, desktop input, game installation or EA effects in this sprint.
expected_outcome: Independent domain results feed strict tier arbitration per portrait and across eligible portraits. The shared callback re-evaluates on a second frame and waits for correlated queue readback.
negative_tests: Stale or missing higher-priority evidence, a full queue and a failed task stay scoped to the affected portrait.
A changed queue or winner, mismatched actor or save, or player takeover denies submission.
An uncertain native admission cannot be replayed or reconciled with an admission capture.
rollback_path: Revert the feature merge. The existing ownership-scoped package can be uninstalled after game close.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build Windows EA sources, registration and a live queue/portrait/rollback trial under #171.
